resources.string: Credits pay for provider-powered processing. You get 10 starter credits per device; one-time credit packs add more. A separate one-time Plinth Unlock removes the free export watermark and five-item batch limit, but does not include processing credits. There is no subscription. The app shows the price and credit cost before you confirm.

The app distinguishes original pixels, manually adjusted images, AI-enhanced images, and images with generated backgrounds. AI-generated results are labelled and can be reported in the app. Plinth does not claim C2PA Content Credentials.
